values.note: Operator's rates page, daily rate for up to 4 people: water & electric 20- or 30-amp $30, 50-amp $35 ($25 / $30 a day for 7 days or more); tent with water & electric $25, tent no hookups $20; extra persons 5 and older $5/day. Seasonal site (April 15 - October 15, 1-4 people) $1,200 + electric. The page carries no year; the server reports it last modified 2026-08-10. Read 2026-10-22.

note: Quiet wooded campground outside Hale (5940 E. Esmond Rd) with water/electric RV sites, remote RV/tent sites and a small lake for shore fishing (children with adults only); seasonal plus weekend/weekly campers. Near ORV trailheads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's own (old-style) site: 20/30/50-amp water & electric sites $30-35 a day for 4 people, no full hookups (sewer false), dump station, bath house with showers, potable water, WiFi; phone 989-728-2267 matches. Rates page undated (server Last-Modified 2026-08-10). Removed rate figures, amps and the RV Life line from the note (fields hold them). Not stated: site count, seasonal share, max rig length, season dates for nightly camping, booking method beyond phone/email.
flags: Mostly-seasonal check: the home page says 'We have seasonal campsites as well as weekend or weekly campsites' and posts a $1,200 April 15 - October 15 seasonal rate. Test 2 passes (nightly rate posted on its own website with a phone, 989-728-2267); the share of seasonal vs nightly sites is not stated anywhere on the site, so test 4 (1 site in 10 nightly) could not be measured.

Rate date: the operator's rates page carries no year (HTTP Last-Modified 2026-08-10). Base $30 is under the US$50 gate either way; no gateway within 40 km (Mackinac 173 km); the family has not stayed here.
